threat_rules.pattern: Actor initiates sensitive action without authentication
threat_rules.match_condition: Actor calls method before any login/auth sequence
threat_rules.impact: Unauthorized actions can be performed
threat_rules.recommendation: Authentication for sensitive API calls is required

threat_rules.pattern: User identity not verified before sensitive operations
threat_rules.match_condition: User performs data modification without identity verification
threat_rules.impact: Data integrity compromised, unauthorized modifications
threat_rules.recommendation: Implement user identity verification before all data operations

threat_rules.match_condition: Data sent over network without encryption indicators
threat_rules.impact: Data can be intercepted and modified in transit
threat_rules.recommendation: Use HTTPS/TLS for all data transmission

threat_rules.pattern: Input validation missing for user data
threat_rules.match_condition: User input accepted without validation
threat_rules.impact: Malicious input can corrupt data or cause system issues
threat_rules.recommendation: Implement comprehensive input validation and sanitization

threat_rules.pattern: No audit trail for sensitive operations
threat_rules.match_condition: Sensitive operations performed without logging
threat_rules.impact: Cannot track who performed what actions
threat_rules.recommendation: Implement comprehensive audit logging for all sensitive operations

threat_rules.pattern: Sensitive data exposed in error messages
threat_rules.match_condition: Error responses contain sensitive information
threat_rules.impact: Sensitive data leaked through error messages
threat_rules.recommendation: Sanitize error messages and implement proper error handling

threat_rules.pattern: Data returned without access control check
threat_rules.match_condition: Data returned without verifying user permissions
threat_rules.impact: Unauthorized access to sensitive data
threat_rules.recommendation: Implement proper access control checks before data retrieval

threat_rules.pattern: No rate limiting on API endpoints
threat_rules.match_condition: API calls without rate limiting mechanisms
threat_rules.impact: System can be overwhelmed by excessive requests
threat_rules.recommendation: Implement rate limiting and request throttling

threat_rules.match_condition: Operations that can consume unlimited resources
threat_rules.impact: System resources can be exhausted
threat_rules.recommendation: Implement resource limits and quotas

threat_rules.pattern: User can access admin functions without proper authorization
threat_rules.match_condition: Regular user performs admin-level operations
threat_rules.impact: Unauthorized access to administrative functions
threat_rules.recommendation: Implement proper role-based access control (RBAC)

threat_rules.match_condition: Sessions remain active indefinitely
threat_rules.impact: Session hijacking and unauthorized access
threat_rules.recommendation: Implement session timeouts and secure session management

threat_rules.pattern: Notes shared via insecure public links
threat_rules.match_condition: Note sharing feature exposes notes via unauthenticated public URLs
threat_rules.impact: Anyone with the link can access sensitive notes
threat_rules.recommendation: Require authentication or expiring links for note sharing

threat_rules.pattern: Weak password policy for user accounts
threat_rules.match_condition: User registration or password change without password strength validation
threat_rules.impact: Accounts can be easily compromised
threat_rules.recommendation: Enforce strong password requirements (length, complexity)

threat_rules.match_condition: User can access app features without verifying email
threat_rules.impact: Fake or mistyped emails can be used, leading to account abuse
threat_rules.recommendation: Require email verification before granting full access

threat_rules.pattern: Excessive permissions granted to regular users
threat_rules.match_condition: User can perform admin or privileged actions
threat_rules.impact: Privilege escalation, data leakage, or accidental changes
threat_rules.recommendation: Apply least privilege principle and review user roles

threat_rules.pattern: No logout or session termination feature
threat_rules.match_condition: User cannot log out or terminate sessions
threat_rules.impact: Sessions may remain active, increasing risk of hijacking
threat_rules.recommendation: Implement logout and session termination endpoints

threat_rules.pattern: No feedback on failed login attempts
threat_rules.match_condition: User receives no message or generic error on failed login
threat_rules.impact: Users may be confused, but no direct security risk
threat_rules.recommendation: Provide clear but non-revealing feedback on login failures

threat_rules.match_condition: User resets password but receives no confirmation
threat_rules.impact: User may not know if password was changed successfully
threat_rules.recommendation: Send confirmation after password reset

threat_rules.match_condition: User can log in with only a password, no MFA available
threat_rules.impact: Authentication, Accounts are more vulnerable to compromise
threat_rules.recommendation: Offer MFA for all users

threat_rules.pattern: No account lockout after repeated failed logins
threat_rules.match_condition: User can attempt unlimited failed logins
threat_rules.impact: Brute-force attacks are possible
threat_rules.recommendation: Lock account or add CAPTCHA after several failed attempts

threat_rules.pattern: No notification on new device login
threat_rules.match_condition: User logs in from new device and receives no alert
threat_rules.impact: User may not be aware of unauthorized access
threat_rules.recommendation: Send notification on new device or location login

threat_rules.match_condition: Notes are saved to database without encryption
threat_rules.impact: If database is compromised, all notes are exposed
threat_rules.recommendation: Encrypt notes at rest in the database

threat_rules.pattern: Excessive error details shown to user
threat_rules.match_condition: Error messages reveal stack traces or internal info
threat_rules.impact: May help attackers learn about the system
threat_rules.recommendation: Show generic errors to users, log details internally

threat_rules.match_condition: User edits notes but changes are lost if browser closes
threat_rules.impact: User may lose data, but no security risk
threat_rules.recommendation: Implement autosave feature for notes

threat_rules.pattern: No warning before deleting a note
threat_rules.match_condition: User can delete notes without confirmation dialog
threat_rules.impact: User may accidentally delete important notes
threat_rules.recommendation: Add confirmation before deleting notes

threat_rules.pattern: Non-sensitive debug info in error messages
threat_rules.match_condition: Error message contains stack trace or debug info but no sensitive data
threat_rules.impact: Minor information disclosure through debug messages
threat_rules.recommendation: Remove debug info from production error messages

threat_rules.match_condition: Note editing without autosave functionality
threat_rules.impact: User may lose unsaved changes
threat_rules.recommendation: Implement autosave functionality for note editing

threat_rules.match_condition: Note deletion without confirmation dialog
threat_rules.impact: Accidental note deletion possible
threat_rules.recommendation: Add confirmation dialog before note deletion

threat_rules.match_condition: Login from new device without user notification
threat_rules.impact: User unaware of new device access
threat_rules.recommendation: Send notification when account is accessed from new device

threat_rules.match_condition: Password change or registration without strength feedback
threat_rules.impact: Users may choose weak passwords
threat_rules.recommendation: Add visual password strength indicator during password entry

threat_rules.match_condition: Session timeout without prior warning
threat_rules.impact: Users may lose unsaved changes due to unexpected session expiry
threat_rules.recommendation: Show warning dialog before session expires

threat_rules.match_condition: Critical actions (e.g., privilege changes, data exports) are not logged or monitored
threat_rules.impact: Malicious or accidental actions may go undetected
threat_rules.recommendation: Log and monitor all critical actions and review logs regularly

threat_rules.match_condition: No alerts on repeated failed logins, privilege escalation, or data exfiltration attempts
threat_rules.impact: Suspicious activity may go unnoticed
threat_rules.recommendation: Implement alerting for suspicious activity and failed logins

threat_rules.match_condition: System is running with debug or verbose logging enabled in production
threat_rules.impact: Sensitive information may be exposed in logs
threat_rules.recommendation: Disable debug mode and verbose logging in production environments

threat_rules.match_condition: Default or weak credentials are present in system setup
threat_rules.impact: System can be easily compromised
threat_rules.recommendation: Change all default credentials and enforce strong password policies

threat_rules.pattern: Sensitive data not encrypted at rest
threat_rules.match_condition: Sensitive fields (passwords, tokens, PII) are not encrypted in storage
threat_rules.impact: Data breach risk if storage is compromised
threat_rules.recommendation: Encrypt all sensitive data at rest

threat_rules.pattern: Sensitive data not encrypted in transit
threat_rules.match_condition: Sensitive data sent over insecure channels (no TLS/SSL)
threat_rules.impact: Data can be intercepted in transit
threat_rules.recommendation: Use TLS/SSL for all sensitive data transmission

threat_rules.match_condition: Lack of output encoding for user-supplied data
threat_rules.impact: Risk of XSS attacks
threat_rules.recommendation: Apply output encoding to all user-supplied data

threat_rules.pattern: No input sanitization for file uploads
threat_rules.match_condition: File uploads are not sanitized or validated
threat_rules.impact: Malicious files may be uploaded
threat_rules.recommendation: Sanitize and validate all file uploads

threat_rules.match_condition: Sessions/tokens are not invalidated on logout
threat_rules.impact: Sessions may remain active after logout
threat_rules.recommendation: Revoke sessions/tokens on logout

threat_rules.match_condition: Refresh tokens are not rotated on use
threat_rules.impact: Stolen refresh tokens can be reused
threat_rules.recommendation: Rotate refresh tokens on every use

threat_rules.match_condition: Users have more permissions than necessary
threat_rules.impact: Increased risk of privilege escalation
threat_rules.recommendation: Enforce least privilege for all users and roles

threat_rules.match_condition: Access rights are not periodically reviewed
threat_rules.impact: Stale or excessive permissions may persist
threat_rules.recommendation: Review and audit access rights regularly

threat_rules.pattern: No rate limiting on sensitive business actions
threat_rules.match_condition: Sensitive actions (e.g., password reset, account creation) lack rate limiting
threat_rules.impact: Sensitive actions can be abused
threat_rules.recommendation: Apply rate limiting to all sensitive business actions

threat_rules.match_condition: No CAPTCHA or bot detection on forms
threat_rules.impact: Automated attacks may succeed
threat_rules.recommendation: Implement CAPTCHA or bot detection on sensitive forms

threat_rules.match_condition: Data is kept longer than necessary
threat_rules.impact: Unnecessary data exposure risk
threat_rules.recommendation: Implement and enforce a data retention policy

threat_rules.pattern: No user consent for data collection
threat_rules.match_condition: User consent is not obtained for PII collection
threat_rules.impact: Legal and compliance risk
threat_rules.recommendation: Obtain user consent for all PII collection
